# Domain and physical parameters
L, nu = 1.0, 0.005
nx, nt = 300, 1500
dx = L / nx
x = np.linspace(0, L, nx, endpoint=False)


u = 0.1 + 0.9 * ((x > 0.2) & (x < 0.5))
# top-hat / step initial condition
cfl, diff_num = 0.5, 0.4
dt = min(cfl * dx / np.max(np.abs(u)), diff_num * dx**2 / nu)

# advective + diffusive CFL

frames = [u.copy()]
for n in range(nt):
    f = 0.5 * u**2
    fp, fm = np.roll(f, -1), np.roll(f, 1)
    up, um = np.roll(u, -1), np.roll(u, 1)
    a_half_p = 0.5 * (u + up)
    a_half_m = 0.5 * (u + um)
    lw_flux_p = 0.5 * (f + fp) - 0.5 * dt / dx * a_half_p * (fp - f)

    lw_flux_m = 0.5 * (f + fm) - 0.5 * dt / dx * a_half_m * (f - fm)
    diffusion = nu * dt / dx**2 * (up - 2 * u + um)
    u = u - dt / dx * (lw_flux_p - lw_flux_m) - diffusion
    # Lax-Wendroff flux
    if n % 10 == 0:
        frames.append(u.copy())
